Labyrinthine.description: Gifted with an innate spatial memory that never loses track of paths.

features.name: Labyrinthine Minotaur
features.tldr: You automatically succeed at checks to recall layouts or avoid getting lost in mazes.

Gore-Bound.description: Bred with heavy muscle and massive horns optimized for charging into battle.

features.name: Gore-Bound Minotaur
features.tldr: Your horn attacks deal increased damage when you finish a movement charge.
